notes: Validated against Trachman et al. Nat Chem Biol 2019 (doi:10.1038/s41589-018-0216-8) and Ryckelynck 2018 Nat Comm. 6C64: Mango-II bound to TO3-Biotin (EKM). Two chains A+B in structure; chain A used for MacDock receptor/ligand. Binding mechanism: EKM thiazolium-quinolinium heterocycles stack directly on G13/G29 of the T3 (tier-3) G-quartet. Five loop adenines (A17, A22, A23, A28 + A14) define the fluorophore binding pocket. A22 most critical: van der Waals to methine linker; A22U mutation improves selectivity (TO1 vs TO3). No phosphate in EKM ligand → only stacking term fires.
